description: Deterministic state -> single-forward-action map for autonomous-between-gates orchestration. plan_next reads this. Human-gate states emit STOP_AT_GATE and point at the human-only recording skill. Nothing here grants, freezes, or authorizes.

DISCOVERY.entry_criteria: A topic and audience have been proposed.
DISCOVERY.acceptance: A product brief exists describing topic, audience, product family, and formats.

NICHE_ASSESSMENT.acceptance: niche/assessment-latest.json written with an opportunity assessment.

NICHE_APPROVAL.acceptance: A human records the niche approval bound to the assessment.

PLANNING.acceptance: content_plan populated with puzzle types, counts, and difficulty progression.

CONTENT_GENERATION.acceptance: Content batches generated deterministically and registered as artifacts.

CONTENT_VERIFICATION.acceptance: verification/content-verification-latest.json = PASS; quality gate PASS. (Interior proof is NOT required here — the interior PDF is built after the interior gate freezes the source, in LAYOUT_AND_FORMAT_BUILD.)

INTERIOR_APPROVAL.entry_criteria: Content verified (verification + quality gate PASS). The interior PDF is built after this gate freezes the source, not before.
INTERIOR_APPROVAL.acceptance: A human records the interior approval; content batches are frozen.

VISUAL_DEVELOPMENT.entry_criteria: Interior approved (page count known for spine math).
VISUAL_DEVELOPMENT.acceptance: Cover wrap built; cover proof written.

COVER_APPROVAL.entry_criteria: Cover built and cover proof passes.
COVER_APPROVAL.acceptance: A human records the cover approval bound to the cover artifact.

LAYOUT_AND_FORMAT_BUILD.acceptance: Print-ready interior/cover PDFs and digital bundle built from the frozen approved source; interior proof PASS (this stage owns the first interior PDF build + proof, gated on LAYOUT_AND_FORMAT_BUILD->ACCESSIBILITY_VALIDATION).

RIGHTS_CLEARANCE.acceptance: rights/gate-latest.json = PASS (all rights-bearing assets cleared or excluded).

COMPLIANCE_APPROVAL.acceptance: A human records the compliance approval (rights + accessibility + AI-content disclosure).

METADATA_AND_COMMERCIAL_PACKAGE.acceptance: metadata/book.json canonical; metadata/validation-report.json = PASS/WARNING; listing kit prepared.

LISTING_APPROVAL.acceptance: A human records the listing approval bound to metadata and listing copy.

FINAL_PROOF.acceptance: Interior and cover proofs PASS on the final built artifacts.

PLATFORM_PACKAGING.acceptance: Per-channel package manifests written with preflight PASS/WARNING for every sales channel.

RELEASE_AUTHORIZATION.entry_criteria: All channel packages pass preflight; listing approved.
RELEASE_AUTHORIZATION.acceptance: Two humans record a release authorization bound to every current package manifest hash.

READY_FOR_SUBMISSION.acceptance: A human performs the manual platform upload under the authorization and records evidence.

PUBLISHED.acceptance: Autonomy stops; monitoring and edition maintenance are human-scheduled.

MONITORING.acceptance: Monitoring notes recorded; a human decides on edition maintenance.

EDITION_MAINTENANCE.acceptance: A human scopes a new edition and re-enters the lifecycle.
